task.title: Compose exact workflow-run discovery filters
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/734 with one read-only filter over authoritative workflow-run projections.
acceptance_criteria: Combine optional exact task, workflow, and lifecycle constraints with logical AND.
Preserve ascending run-ID order, deterministic reopen behavior, and empty results.
Fail the complete query on malformed candidate history.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests failed to compile because WorkflowRunFilter and list_filtered did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added unconstrained, single-constraint, compound, reopen, empty-match, and malformed-history cases.

attempts.summary: Implemented one shared authoritative filter boundary.
attempts.diagnostic: Filtering complete projected runs reused existing replay validation and avoided divergent indexes or lifecycle classifiers.
attempts.patch: Added WorkflowRunFilter and delegated existing task, workflow, and status queries through list_filtered.

outcome.summary: Callers can compose exact workflow-run recovery constraints without gaining mutation, scheduling, execution, or authorization authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_run_store

lessons: Composable recovery queries should share authoritative replay rather than duplicate projection rules.
All supplied exact constraints form an AND predicate while an unconstrained filter remains equivalent to list.
Historical discovery does not imply execution or lifecycle authority.
